# Volcano plots


```{r volcano, results="verbatim"}
if (!all(e$gsm %in% rownames(bsseq::pData(bs)))) {stop("problem gsm vs. rownames(bsseq::pData(bs))")}
# countData = raw_counts[,e$gsm]
# colnames(countData) = rownames(e)
# colData = e[colnames(countData),]
# # Vérifie que les noms de colonnes correspondent
# if (!all(colnames(countData) == rownames(colData))) {stop("probleme data vs. e")}


for (k in factoi) {
  # k = "hiloDDE"
  print(k)
  model_formula = paste0("~", k)
  frmula = formula(model_formula)
  tmpbs = bs[, !is.na(bsseq::pData(bs)[[k]])]
  fit = DSS::DMLfit.multiFactor(tmpbs, design=bsseq::pData(tmpbs), formula=frmula)
  # saveRDS(fit, "fit.rds")
  # fit = readRDS("fit.rds")
  res = DSS::DMLtest.multiFactor(fit, coef=colnames(fit$X)[2])
  rownames(res) = paste0(res[,1], ":", res[,2])

  # dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  #   countData = countData[,rownames(colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),])],
  #   colData = colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),],
  #   design = frmula
  # )
  # dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  # res <- DESeq2::results(dds)

  head(res[is.na(res$pvals),])
  sum(!is.na(res$pvals))
  sum(is.na(res$pvals))
  sum(!is.na(res$fdrs))
  res = res[!is.na(res$pvals),]
  # res = res[!is.na(res$fdrs),]

  layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
  plot(res$stat, -log10(res$pvals), xlab="stat", ylab="-log10(pval)", main=frmula)
  plot(res$stat, -log10(res$fdrs) , xlab="stat", ylab="-log10(fdrs)", main=frmula)

  if (is.factor(bsseq::pData(tmpbs)[[k]])) {
    M   = bsseq::getCoverage(tmpbs, type = "M")
    Cov = bsseq::getCoverage(tmpbs, type = "Cov")
    grp = bsseq::pData(tmpbs)[[k]]
    names(grp) = rownames(bsseq::pData(tmpbs))
    
    grp_ctrl = names(grp)[grp == levels(grp)[1]]
    grp_case = names(grp)[grp == levels(grp)[2]]
    
    eff = data.frame(
      chr     = as.character(seqnames(bs)),
      pos     = start(bs),
      meth_ctrl = rowSums(M[, grp_ctrl]) / rowSums(Cov[, grp_ctrl]),
      meth_case = rowSums(M[, grp_case]) / rowSums(Cov[, grp_case])
    )
    eff$diff = eff$meth_case - eff$meth_ctrl
    rownames(eff) = paste0(eff[,1], ":", eff[,2])
    res$betaDiff = eff[rownames(res), ]$diff
  } else {
    M = bsseq::getCoverage(tmpbs, type = "M")
    Cov = bsseq::getCoverage(tmpbs, type = "Cov")
    x   = as.numeric(bsseq::pData(tmpbs)[[k]])
    names(x) = rownames(bsseq::pData(tmpbs))
    x   = x[colnames(M)]                       # make sure samples are in the same order

    # weighted sums per CpG (samples with Cov = 0 get zero weight automatically)
    Sw   = rowSums(Cov)                        # sum of weights
    Swx  = as.vector(Cov %*% x)                # sum w * x
    Swxx = as.vector(Cov %*% (x^2))            # sum w * x^2
    Swy  = rowSums(M)                          # sum w * y   (since w * y = M)
    Swxy = as.vector(M %*% x)                  # sum w * x * y

    Sxx = Swxx - Swx^2 / Sw                    # weighted variance of x (per CpG)
    Sxy = Swxy - Swx * Swy / Sw                # weighted covariance of x and y (per CpG)
    slope = Sxy / Sxx                          # methylation change (fraction) per unit of x

    eff = data.frame(
      chr   = as.character(seqnames(tmpbs)),
      pos   = start(tmpbs),
      slope = slope
    )
    rownames(eff) = paste0(eff$chr, ":", eff$pos)

    # slope per unit of x (e.g. per year); optionally rescale (e.g. per decade)
    res$betaDiff = eff[rownames(res), ]$slope
    # res$betaDiff = res$betaDiff * 10
  }

  layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
  plot(res$betaDiff, -log10(res$pvals), xlab="betaDiff", ylab="-log10(pval)", main=frmula)
  plot(res$betaDiff, -log10(res$fdrs) , xlab="betaDiff", ylab="-log10(fdrs)", main=frmula)

  # res = res[order(res$betaDiff), ]
  idx = rownames(res)[!is.na(res$fdrs)&res$fdrs< 0.05]
  # print(cbind(pf[idx,2:4], res[idx, c("betaDiff", "pvals", "fdrs") ]))
  print(res[idx,])

  model_func_name = "dss"  
  prefix3 = paste0(gse, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula)

  # tmp_df = cbind(pf[rownames(res),], res)
  # tmp_df = cbind(pf[rownames(res),], res)
  # head(tmp_df)
  # WriteXLS::WriteXLS(tmp_df, paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".xlsx"))

  # gsea_input = cbind(rownames(tmp_df), tmp_df$betaDiff)
  # head(gsea_input)
  # dim(gsea_input)
  # gsea_input_filename = paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".rnk")
  # write.table(gsea_input, gsea_input_filename, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

  bed = res[,c(1, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 6, 6)]
  head(bed)
  bed[,3] = bed[,2]+1
  bed[,4] = rownames(bed)
  # bed[,5] = bed$pvals
  bed[,6] = "+"
  # bed[,7] = bed$betaDiff
  bed[,8] = -log10(bed[,5])  
  bed = bed[,1:8]
  colnames(bed) = c("#chrom", "start", "end", "probes", "pval", "strand", "l2fc", "lpv")
  head(bed)
  dim(bed)

  # write ewas res for combp
  bed[,1] = as.character(bed[,1])
  bed = bed[order(bed[,1], bed[,2]),]
  bed_ewas_filename = paste0("ewas4combp_", prefix3, ".bed")
  write.table(bed, file=bed_ewas_filename , sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
  # bed_on_disk = read.table(bed_ewas_filename, sep="\t", header=TRUE)




  # ---- DMR calling on the fitted model (DSS::callDMR) ----
  # For a multiFactor result there is no 'diff' column, so delta=0;
  # p.threshold applies to per-CpG p-values (pvals column).
  p_thr     = 0.001  # to be tuned (DSS default is 1e-5, very strict)
  minlen    = 50     # minimum region length (bp)
  minCG     = 3      # minimum number of CpGs per region
  dis_merge = 100    # max distance to merge nearby regions (bp)

  dmrs = DSS::callDMR(res, delta=0, p.threshold=p_thr, minlen=minlen,
                      minCG=minCG, dis.merge=dis_merge)
  cat(k, ": ", ifelse(is.null(dmrs), 0, nrow(dmrs)), "DMRs\n")

  if (!is.null(dmrs) && nrow(dmrs) > 0) {
    # Mean effect size per DMR (case - ctrl methylation difference, averaged over CpGs)
    gr_dmr = GenomicRanges::GRanges(dmrs$chr, IRanges::IRanges(dmrs$start, dmrs$end))
    gr_cpg = GenomicRanges::GRanges(res$chr, IRanges::IRanges(res$pos, res$pos))
    ov = GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(gr_cpg, gr_dmr)
    dmrs$meanDiff = tapply(res$betaDiff[S4Vectors::queryHits(ov)],
                           factor(S4Vectors::subjectHits(ov), levels=seq_len(nrow(dmrs))),
                           mean, na.rm=TRUE)
    dmrs$meanStat = tapply(res$stat[S4Vectors::queryHits(ov)],
                           factor(S4Vectors::subjectHits(ov), levels=seq_len(nrow(dmrs))),
                           mean, na.rm=TRUE)

    # Optional filter on effect size
    dmrs_f = dmrs[!is.na(dmrs$meanDiff) & abs(dmrs$meanDiff) >= 0.1, ]
    cat(nrow(dmrs_f), "DMRs with |meanDiff| >= 0.1\n")

    # Outputs
    dmr_prefix = paste0("dmrdss_", prefix3)
    saveRDS(dmrs, paste0(dmr_prefix, ".rds"))
    write.table(dmrs, paste0(dmr_prefix, ".tsv"), sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
    write.table(dmrs[,c("chr","start","end")], paste0(dmr_prefix, ".bed"),
                sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)

    # Diagnostics
    layout(matrix(1:3,1), respect=TRUE)
    hist(dmrs$length, breaks=50, main="DMR length", xlab="bp")
    hist(dmrs$nCG,    breaks=50, main="CpGs per DMR", xlab="nCG")
    plot(dmrs$meanDiff, dmrs$areaStat, xlab="meanDiff", ylab="areaStat",
         main=paste(k, "- DMR"))
    abline(v=0, lty=2)
    head(dmrs[order(-abs(dmrs$areaStat)), ])
  }

}
```
